title: Triage rules
intro: Rules applied by triage, in evaluation order: only pending items, and an item takes the first rule that matches. Scope "All" applies to every project; a specific one only to upgrade or conversion. The remediation play applies the active rules of the session's project type.
form.builtInHint: Standard rule: the logic stays in the code. Here you change the code, the description, the scope, whether it is active, the parameters the logic uses and an additional filter. The effect does not change.
form.codeHint: Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (e.g. ZR10).
form.codeInvalid: Invalid code: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (up to 40).
form.refObjectsHint: Comma-separated (e.g. BSEG, KONV). The item matches if its referenced object is in the list.
form.criteriaRequired: Enter at least one criterion: referenced objects, object name or check/message text.
form.refsRequired: Enter at least one referenced object.
form.codeBuiltInHint: You can rename it. Key {{key}} does not change: the note written on the item stays "Triagem {{key}}: …" (read by the R1 check, the exemption and the report). Already triaged items keep the old code.
form.extraFilterHint: Optional: the rule only applies to items that also match these criteria.
